risk_note: RV2 payout channel layer (withdraw lane B2-06b; model Claude Fable 5.1). PayoutChannel contract, FakeChannel (dry_run only, scripted, never touches the network), AlipayChannel (alipay.fund.trans.uni.transfer / common.query; RSA2 written here per D-W11 with no SDK; credentials injected, never read from the environment; payee name required; one request per call with a 10 s AbortSignal deadline; response node verified on its original bytes with the Alipay public key; judged only by the configured BR-WDR-28 lists: success needs code 10000 and status SUCCESS, any other business code is unknown and pauses the queue, transport-class outcomes are unknown without pausing — D10-230), BankCard / Wechat closed adapters, payout.* configuration reader with conservative defaults and the eight keys registered in content's config-registry. Logs carry out_biz_no / code / sub_code / latency_ms with the logon id masked. Rule tests: Codex round 1 (41 cases, engine codex) and an independent Claude round 2 (134 cases after spec-test r1 S1: separate application and Alipay key pairs; engine claude-independent, Codex at its usage limit from 2026-10-23 10:2x). One mechanical fix of [AC-B2-06b#45] (D10-206: `.then<unknown>` so the frozen test type-checks; assertions untouched) as spec commit 4ed59526, reported in notices.
